_comment: Run through both copies of the configuration schema validator: lma_config/schema.py (pytest, test_schema.py) and the web UI schema-validation.js (vitest). Each case lists the exact problems both must report, in order.

cases.name: wrong type stops further checks
problems: (the value): must be text; got a number

cases.name: a boolean is not a number
problems: (the value): must be a number; got a boolean

cases.name: a whole number is an integer
a fraction is not an integer
problems: (the value): must be a whole number; got a number

cases.name: null is named as null
problems: (the value): must be text; got null

cases.name: a list is not an object
problems: (the value): must be an object; got a list

cases.name: one of several types refused
problems: (the value): must be text or null; got a number

cases.name: enum refuses an unlisted value
problems: (the value): must be one of "a", "b"; got "c"

cases.name: enum true is not 1
problems: (the value): must be one of 1; got true

cases.name: enum quotes text as written
problems: (the value): must be one of "café"; got "cafe"

cases.name: minimum
problems: (the value): must be at least 0; got -0.5

cases.name: maximum
problems: (the value): must be at most 10; got 11

cases.name: empty text where minLength is 1
problems: (the value): must not be empty

cases.name: minLength above 1
problems: (the value): must be at least 3 characters

cases.name: maxLength exceeded
problems: (the value): must be at most 2 characters; got 3

cases.name: pattern is a search, not a full match
pattern refused
problems: (the value): "12a" does not match ^[0-9]+$

cases.name: an end anchor does not match before a final newline
problems: (the value): "abc\n" does not match ^[a-z]+$

cases.name: an escaped dollar is a character
a dot does not match a carriage return
problems: (the value): "1#A\r" does not match ^[0-9]+#.+$

cases.name: a dot inside a character class is a dot
a whole-number float is written as JavaScript writes it
problems: (the value): must be at least 0; got -1

cases.name: a small number is written as JavaScript writes it
problems: (the value): must be at most 1e-8; got 7e-8

cases.name: a number below one millionth
problems: (the value): must be at least 0.000025; got 1e-7

cases.name: unknown property refused
problems: b: is not a setting this section has

cases.name: pattern properties checked, unmatched refused
problems: 2#B: must be text; got a number
C: is not a setting this section has

cases.name: additional properties schema checked
problems: y: must be at least 0; got -1

cases.name: property names refused before values
problems: Bad: the name does not match ^[a-z]+$

cases.name: nested maps report the full path
problems: default › transcribe/streaming: must be at least 0; got -2

cases.name: list items numbered from one
problems: item 2: must be text; got a number
item 4: must be text; got null

cases.name: minItems
problems: (the value): must hold at least 2 items

cases.name: maxItems
problems: (the value): must hold at most 1 item

cases.name: required
problems: (the value): "b" is required

cases.name: required looks only at the value's own keys
problems: (the value): "toString" is required

cases.name: maxProperties
problems: (the value): must hold at most 1 entry

cases.name: several problems on one value, in order
problems: (the value): must be one of "abcdef"; got "abcd"
(the value): must be at most 3 characters; got 4
(the value): "abcd" does not match ^x
